description: Defines the NodeId class and related classes for network address representation, supporting IPv4, IPv6, domain sockets, netlink, Bluetooth, and packet sockets, with methods for address manipulation and querying.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Represents a network node address supporting multiple address families and protocols, with methods for address management and comparison.

classes.name: IPNode
classes.description: Derived from NodeId, adds subnet mask functionality for IP addresses.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns protocol-specific extension data for the socket address.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the address family type of the NodeId.

methods.name: PortNumber
methods.description: Gets or sets the port number associated with the NodeId.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the NodeId is valid (not unspecified or empty).

methods.name: HostName
methods.description: Retrieves the hostname associated with the NodeId.

methods.name: HostAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address as a string.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two NodeId objects for equality.
